title: Outcome of revascularization therapy in traumatized immature incisors
authors: Mittmann, C. W., Kostka, E., Ballout, H., Preus, M., Preissner, R., Karaman, M., & Preissner, S. BMC Oral Health. 2020 Jul;20(1), 1-10. doi: 10.1186/s12903-020-01193-5. * collafleece®
supports: Clinical study from the botiss collacone / collafleece (collagen cone and fleece) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “Revascularization is a promising approach for the treatment of immature incisors to regain sensitivity and to enhance apical closure and at least to maintain alveolar bone in terms of a socket preservation. Further studies have to be performed to determin e ideal conditions (type of trauma, age, width of apical foramen) for a revascularization” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
